notes: Dev ABox revision on capital_of (Aztec Empire to Inca Empire for Tenochtitlan). The original, 'Tenochtitlan was the capital of the Aztec Empire', is stored. Risk, recorded: 'Aztec' names the builders of the Templo Mayor and its culture, so a model may answer the Aztec Empire to the related question from that attribution; but a model holding the temple in Tenochtitlan and Tenochtitlan in the Inca Empire while putting the temple in the Aztec Empire is inconsistent, so the query stays determinate. The derived queries avoid every fact stored about Tenochtitlan by name. Two compositions name the Inca Empire as 'the empire whose capital was Tenochtitlan' and ask facts stored about the empire only (who built Machu Picchu; whether Pachacuti ruled it). The third is a chain (capital_of, then located_in): the Inca Empire lay in South America, so a city that is its capital does too. The related question is the Templo Mayor's empire, changed through one bridge (the Templo Mayor stood in Tenochtitlan).
